annotations.title: Get Structured Monster and Quest Facts

description:
Read structured RS3 combat-monster statistics or quest metadata. Use search_wiki for title discovery, get_wiki_page_content for reviewed text/source links, or get_item_details for GE records.

- page must name a main-namespace article, such as "Abyssal demon" or "Cook's Assistant". Redirects resolve; URLs, #variants, |separators and Category: titles are rejected.
- kind=monster selects combat facts; kind=quest selects quest, miniquest, subquest or saga metadata. A title/dataset mismatch errors rather than guessing.
- limit bounds that page's variants, not search hits. Inspect each reference to choose a variant; none is implicit. If truncated, increase limit up to 10 or follow sourceUrl. There is no cursor, and entity IDs are not GE IDs.

Results contain numeric/Boolean facts, controlled labels, dates and references, without article prose or images. Index reads are uncached and may lag.

No credentials are required. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.

kind.description: Structured dataset: combat monster statistics or quest metadata

limit.description: Maximum variant records from the selected page (default 5)

page.description: Wiki page title, e.g. Abyssal demon or Cook's Assistant; redirects are resolved

name: get_wiki_entity_facts

license.description: No article-content license or review is inferred for these index facts

ids.description: Wiki-indexed entity IDs, not GE item IDs

reference.description: Indexed page/variant identifier, not article text

truncated.description: Additional indexed variants exceeded the requested limit
